rule: Flag source year absent from any supporting questions, within band/TV/film/story queries.
review_finding: All6 inspected: no definite dropped-intermediate-identification year; years constrain the final target or another operand. This rule alone cannot detect semantic errors.

cases.query: In what 1942 British romance film did actress/singer Jane Birkin's mother star in?
target: Who was actress/singer Jane Birkin's mother?

cases.query: The film "Intermezzo" was produced by a man that won an Academy Award for Best Picture for what 1939 film?
target: Who was the man who produced the film Intermezzo?

cases.query: The creator of the animates series, based on a novel by Robert A. Heinlein, also directed which film in 1992?

Who created the animated series based on a novel by Robert A. Heinlein?

target: Which 2002 horror film collaboration consists of three omnibus segments by directors from three Asian countries?
